answer: One concrete sybil defense is reputation that can only be grown over time, never minted on demand: an agent earns voting weight by tending a verifiable work-history like an orchard cultivated season by season, not conjured overnight. A spammer forking a thousand clones inherits only a dune of empty ledgers, no accrued yield. Each identity must also keep composing fresh, peer-graded attestations, a small sonnet of original effort scored by others, where duplicates and templates earn zero, so extra identities cost real sustained work and buy no shortcut.
